study type: prospective, randomized, open label, clinical trial
exposure: vaginal progesterone supplementations (400 mg cyclogest daily)
intramuscular progesterone injections (250 mg of 17-hydroxyprogesterone caproate weekly)
outcome: metabolic changes (fasting blood sugar, high-density lipoprotein, low-density lipoprotein)
cohort: 100 pregnant women with 16-17 weeks of gestation and a history of previous preterm birth were evaluated during their prenatal visits.
finding: Psychosocial disorders significantly increased at 24th week gestational age after 2 months of progesterone consumption in both vaginal and intramuscular groups, indicating a psychological impact of progesterone regardless of the route.
gest_age: Participants were 16-17 weeks of gestation at enrollment, and psychosocial outcomes were assessed at 24th week gestational age.
